entities.name: Monasteriat
entities.description: An insular and esoteric governing body of hundreds of elector monks in the Edge that administers Monoist doctrine from the Lip of Susur.

entities.name: Monoism
entities.description: An ancient unitary faith practiced by multiple species that holds the Immortal Faller approaches every supervoid and INEVITA is the perfect future beyond it.

entities.name: Summism
entities.description: The rival faith that competes with Monoism as the most widespread in Pinnacle space.

entities.name: Summist Celestial Palatinate
entities.description: The Summist power engaged with the Monasteriat in the Entropy War.

entities.name: Entropy War
entities.description: The war between the Monasteriat and the Summist Celestial Palatinate.

entities.name: Immortal Faller
entities.description: The savior and first prophet of the Monoist faith, observed approaching the center of every supervoid.

entities.name: Tezzeret
entities.description: Described the Monasteriat as an entropic death cult and questioned the existence of the Faller.

entities.name: Point Prime
entities.description: The first and most holy supervoid of the Monoist faith, formed from the collapsed star Susur.

entities.name: Lip of Susur
entities.description: The photon collar ringing Point Prime and capital of the faith, what remains of the star that birthed Point Prime.

entities.name: Susurians
entities.description: The native species of the Susur system who divined the first tenets of Monoism.

entities.name: Sothera
entities.description: The one-thousandth supervoid created by the Monoists.

entities.name: The Plummet Record
entities.description: The Monoist religious text in two volumes, believed to come from the Faller.

entities.name: INEVITA
entities.description: The promised, inevitable end of the universe, believed to be an Elysian paradise.

entities.name: Gravkill paladins
entities.description: Leaders of the Monasteriat's volunteer military, clad in alabile gravkill suits.

events.summary: In ancient times the star Susur collapses into a supervoid, later called Point Prime, and the Susurians found Monoism.
events.quote: In ancient times, the star Susur collapsed into a supervoid, later called Point Prime.

events.summary: The Monoists create nine hundred ninety-nine supervoids since Point Prime, Sothera being the thousandth.
events.quote: The Monoists have created nine hundred ninety-nine supervoids since Point Prime, with Sothera as their one-thousandth.

events.summary: The Monasteriat and the Summist Celestial Palatinate are engaged in the Entropy War.
events.quote: The Monasteriat and the Summist Celestial Palatinate are engaged in the Entropy War .

relations.quote: The Monasteriat and the Summist Celestial Palatinate are engaged in the Entropy War .

relations.note: Competes with Summism; Monoists protect supervoids from the Summists.
relations.quote: It competes with Summism as the most widespread faith in Pinnacle space

relations.note: The faith revolves around the Faller's transmissions.
relations.quote: The Immortal Faller is the name of the savior and first prophet of the Monoist faith.

relations.note: The photon collar that rings Point Prime.
relations.quote: the photon collar that rings Point Prime

relations.note: Described them as an entropic death cult.
relations.quote: Tezzeret described the Monasteriat as entropic death cult
